name: Asia Pack Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1987, Asia Pack Ltd is engaged in the real estate business.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
APL is in the business of:
a) Trading of raw paper & paper products, and packaging material etc. 
b) Providing advisory & consultancy services in different fields like legal, 
financial, commercial, accountancy, and all 
other related services.
c) Currently, the co. is in the business of 
providing real estate services.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.40 times its book value
Debtor days have improved from 118 to 17.4 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 1.05% over last 3 years.
